In Cyclus an archetype is type of facility. Different facilities operate in materials in different ways. 'Cycamore' is a library for Cyclus where these particular definitions are stored - do not worry about this, it does not matter for the assignment. The role of each should be fairly clear from the rest of the input and the fuel cycle diagram provided with the assignment. More information is however available here http://fuelcycle.org/user/cycamoreagents.html You will only need these archetypes for completing the assignment. You may not need all of them for every exercise.
